description.zh: 数据平面集群ID。填写该参数时，不能填写ServiceMeshId。该参数和ServiceMeshId不能同时为空。
description.en: The ID of the data plane cluster. You must specify either this parameter or ServiceMeshId, but not both.

description.zh:
负载均衡类型，取值：

- `clb`：传统型负载均衡

- `nlb`：网络型负载均衡

默认为`clb`。
description.en:
The type of the load balancer. Valid values:

- `clb`: Classic Load Balancer

- `nlb`: Network Load Balancer (NLB)

The default value is `clb`.

description.zh:
网络类型，取值：

- `intranet`：专有网络

- `internet`：公网
description.en:
The network type. Valid values:

- `intranet`: virtual private cloud (VPC)

- `internet`: Internet

description.zh: ASM实例ID。填写该参数时，不能填写K8sClusterId。该参数和K8sClusterId不能同时为空。
description.en: The ID of the ASM instance. You must specify either this parameter or K8sClusterId, but not both.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh describe-reusable-slb --k8s-cluster-id ca2cfe41fefeb489d9b9dba18a7c50000 --network-type internet --lb-type clb --service-mesh-id cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DescribeReusableSlb --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --NetworkType internet --LbType clb --K8sClusterId ca2cfe41fefeb489d9b9dba18a7c50000
